description: Source code for the Orleans TestingHost component, specifically implementing the StandaloneSiloHandle class which manages starting, stopping, and handling silo processes in a testing environment.

classes.name: StandaloneSiloHandle
classes.description: Manages a silo process, handling its lifecycle including starting, stopping, and output/error handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Spawns a new silo process using configuration and executable path.

methods.name: CreateDelegate
methods.description: Provides a delegate to spawn silos with a specified executable path.

methods.name: CreateForAssembly
methods.description: Returns a delegate to spawn silos based on an assembly's location, handling dll/exe distinctions.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the process asynchronously and handles initial output for readiness signals.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync
methods.description: Stops the silo process asynchronously, either gracefully or forcefully.

methods.name: StopSiloAsync(CancellationToken)
methods.description: Stops the process with cancellation support.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the process resources and stops the silo if still active.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous disposal of resources and process cleanup.
